# defectdojo_engagement (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo engagement by ID, or by product and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_product" "storefront" {
  name = "Storefront"
}

# Engagement names need not be unique, so a name lookup needs the product.
data "defectdojo_engagement" "ci" {
  product_id = data.defectdojo_product.storefront.id
  name       = "CI/CD"
}

data "defectdojo_engagement" "by_id" {
  id = 15
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the engagement to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the engagement to look up in the product `product_id`, compared exactly and case-sensitively. Engagement names need not be unique: the lookup fails when the product has several engagements with the name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `product_id` (Number) The ID of the product of the engagement. Required with `name`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the engagement is open.
- `api_test` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes API tests.
- `branch_tag` (String) The branch or tag the engagement tests, or null.
- `build_id` (String) The ID of the build the engagement tests, or null.
- `check_list` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes a check list.
- `commit_hash` (String) The commit the engagement tests, or null.
- `deduplication_on_engagement` (Boolean) Whether findings are only deduplicated within the engagement.
- `description` (String) The description of the engagement, or null.
- `engagement_type` (String) The type of the engagement: `Interactive` or `CI/CD`.
- `first_contacted` (String) The date of the first contact, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null.
- `lead_id` (Number) The ID of the user who leads the engagement, or null.
- `pen_test` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes penetration tests.
- `reason` (String) The reason for the engagement, or null.
- `source_code_management_uri` (String) The link to the source code the engagement tests, or null.
- `status` (String) The status of the engagement.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the engagement, including those its product passes on.
- `target_end` (String) The date the engagement ends, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `target_start` (String) The date the engagement starts, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `test_strategy` (String) The link to the test strategy of the engagement, or null.
- `threat_model` (Boolean) Whether the engagement includes threat modelling.
- `tracker` (String) The link to the epic or ticket of the engagement, or null.
- `version` (String) The version of the product the engagement tests, or null.
